value.rationale: The cycle type (7,1) is the canonical prime-order action of S8 fixing exactly one label. M8 is the first simply connected complete-graph matching complex on which that order-seven action is free. This supplies an exact integral homotopy classification of the ordinary symmetry quotient, showing emergent order-seven first-homology torsion and eighteen independent two-sphere summands despite the torsion-free homology of the covering complex. The precise Moore-space splitting is strictly stronger than a Betti-number or Euler-characteristic calculation, and the calculation resolves a natural finite equivariant topology problem without asserting general-order results.
